title: G2: PROGRESS
description: A Counter-Strike hype film for G2 ahead of the BLAST Paris Major.
overview: PROGRESS brings G2’s competitive energy into a cinematic Counter-Strike world. Created as a hype video for the BLAST Paris Major, the film builds anticipation around the team’s next challenge.

Slow-motion projectiles, close-up character shots and bold G2 imagery give the sequence its rhythm. Warm industrial scenes contrast with dark silhouettes and red accents, while floating banknotes and graphic transitions bring a playful edge to the action.
